description: This file defines UI components and design tokens for an Android TV frontend using Jetpack Compose, including color schemes, spacing, shapes, typography, and composable UI elements like buttons, posters, and image banners.

classes.name: TvColors
classes.description: Object containing core color tokens for the UI theme.

classes.name: TvSpacing
classes.description: Object defining spacing tokens for consistent layout spacing.

classes.name: TvRadius
classes.description: Object defining shape corner radius tokens.

classes.name: TvTypography
classes.description: Object defining text styles for the UI.

methods.name: StreamXTVTheme
methods.description: Applies a dark theme with custom color scheme and typography for the app.

methods.name: figmaImage
methods.description: Constructs a File object pointing to a Figma image asset.

methods.name: SvgImage
methods.description: Loads and displays an SVG or PNG image from local assets using Coil.

methods.name: HeroBanner
methods.description: Displays a large hero banner image with cropping and focusability.

methods.name: RowSection
methods.description: Displays a horizontal scrollable row of items with a title.

methods.name: TagChip
methods.description: Displays a small rounded tag or chip, e.g., for live status.

methods.name: TvIconButton
methods.description: Creates a circular icon button with optional icon overlay.

methods.name: PosterCard
methods.description: Displays a poster image with optional progress bar and action icons.

methods.name: borderGlow
methods.description: Adds a glow/border effect to a Modifier for focus highlight.
